caption: Precision @ L/2 on the same 314 natural proteins and first 100 saved iid samples per protein. L is frozen input length; k=max(1,floor(L/2)). Individual maps retain emission order after resolved-pair filtering and deduplication; short maps retain denominator k, invalid/unfinished maps score zero. Consensus ranks votes from all parsed maps, matching the original sampling diagnostic; the main contact comparison instead omits unfinished maps. Oracle best-of-100 is reselected by P@L/2 and uses ground truth. All-range separation >=6; long-range >=24, applied before cutoff. Bars are equal-protein means with 95% bootstrap intervals; scatter pairs consensus and oracle within protein. Interactive colors show Neff80 tiers. This measures contact accuracy, not distinct folds. Sources: pl2_sampling_summary.csv, pl2_sampling_figure_rows.csv and pl2_sampling_individual.csv.gz. See SAMPLING_L2.md.
